                            P R O C E E D I N G S

                             ACTING PRESIDENT KUHL:    The

                 Senate will come to order.

                             I ask the members to take their

                 chairs, staff to find their places.

                             I ask everybody in the chamber to

                 rise and join me in saying the Pledge of

                 Allegiance to the Flag.

                             (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

                 the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

                             ACTING PRESIDENT KUHL:    In the

                 absence of clergy, may we bow our heads in a

                 moment of silence.

                             (Whereupon, the assemblage

                 respected a moment of silence.)

                             ACTING PRESIDENT KUHL:    Reading

                 of the Journal.

                             THE SECRETARY:    In Senate,

                 Thursday, August 2nd, the Senate met pursuant

                 to adjournment.  The Journal of Wednesday,

                 August 1st, was read and approved.  On motion,

                 Senate adjourned.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT KUHL:    Hearing

                 no objection, the Journal stands approved as

                 read.

                 amend the General Business Law.

                 authorizing the City of New York.

                 on Rules, an act to amend the Education Law.

                 reading.

                 motion is to accept the report of the Rules

                 Committee.

                 the report of the Rules Committee.

                 in favor of accepting the report of the Rules

                 Committee signify by saying aye.





                                                          11283



                             (Response of "Aye.")

                 nay.

                 report is accepted.

                 third reading.

                 Duane, why do you rise?

                             SENATOR DUANE:    I'm confused.

                 What calendar are we on, Mr. President?

                             ACTING PRESIDENT KUHL:    There is

                 no printed calendar per se which has a listing

                 of all the bills.  We're calling up individual

                 bills that were just reported out from one of

                 the committees.  So the bills are actually on

                 your desk with a calendar number on them.

                             If you're looking at your bills,

                 Senator Duane, and you're finding a bill that

                 says 1475 on it, and 1476, they were

                 incorrectly marked, I'm informed by the desk.

                 They should have read 1432 and 1433,

                 respectively.

                             If you wish to change your vote -

                 Senator Duane, if you wish to change your vote

                 on any of those bills, certainly now would be

                 the time to do that, we would entertain that.





                                                          11288

                 would move that we at this time recommit all

                 outstanding bills on the calendar to Rules.

                 objection, all bills, outstanding bills on the

                 calendar are recommitted to Rules.

                 no further business to come before the Senate,

                 to the call of the Majority Leader, with

                 intervening days being legislative days.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT KUHL:    Without

                 objection, the Senate stands adjourned,

                 subject to the call of the Majority Leader,

                 intervening days to be legislative days.
